title: Why linear means a line
question: Why is a linear equation called linear?
hook: Plot every answer to certain equations and the dots refuse to scatter.
idea: In two variables the solutions of a linear equation lie on a straight line, and every straight line comes from one.

beats.prompt: You list many pairs (x, y) that satisfy one linear equation in two variables and plot them as points. What do you see?

choices.label: They all fall on one straight line
They scatter across the whole plane
choices.feedback: Many pairs fit, but only those satisfying the equation count, and they line up.

choices.label: They form a bowl-shaped curve
choices.feedback: Curves come from equations with squared terms, not linear ones.

choices.label: Only a single point appears
choices.feedback: With two variables there are infinitely many solutions, not one.

beats.explain: The solutions of a linear equation in two variables form a line, which is the origin of the word linear.

beats.prompt: Match the number of variables to the solutions.
beats.explain: One variable gives a single solution; more variables give lines and then hyperplanes.

beats.prompt: An engineer faces a curvy, non-linear system. Why might linear equations still help?

choices.label: Curvy systems are always exactly linear
choices.feedback: They are not; the claim is only about approximation.

choices.label: Linear equations never need solving
choices.feedback: Solving them is still the point.

choices.label: Non-linear systems are often well approximated by linear ones
Curves cannot be described in math
choices.feedback: They can; they are just harder than lines.

beats.explain: Linear equations are common in physics and engineering partly because non-linear systems are often well approximated by them.

beats.prompt: One step in this reasoning is wrong. Which?
steps: Take a two-variable linear equation ax + by + c = 0 where b = 0.
Then x is pinned to one fixed value.
So the solutions form a vertical line.
A vertical line is the graph of a function of x, giving one height for each x.
beats.explain: When b = 0 the line is vertical, which is not the graph of a function of x.
